summary: The workspace uses Concurrently's CLI alias for parallel TypeScript builds, and the supplied commands do not show the v9 signal-handling flags or programmatic API affected by its breaking changes.

findings.title: Existing build command avoids the flagged CLI break
findings.impact: Both workspace packages run the conc alias with only the npm:build-* selector; the documented interruption change applies when max-processes is combined with interruption or kill behavior, none of which appears in the supplied commands.
recommendedChecks: Confirm CI uses Node.js 18 or newer, then run both existing build scripts and interrupt one run to verify expected child-process shutdown.

omittedConcerns: The programmatic export change is omitted because no JavaScript or TypeScript import of concurrently appears in the supplied repository evidence.
The max-processes and kill-option behavior is not claimed as current usage because those flags do not appear in the supplied commands.
